scope: Rehearse enabling the upstream (new) backend for new sessions in an isolated fixture, prove old sessions stay on the legacy engine with no page/ref/cursor reuse, prove a broken upstream fails closed, and bind the rollback version set. The product default stays legacy.

criterion_2_rollback_version_set_and_use.userData: Empirically: a task written through the module's persisted store is recovered unchanged by a fresh reader on the same file, the store stays version 2, and the reader does not rewrite it (m11-state-readback.json). No migration runs on this cutover because the default selector stays legacy, so existing task-store/vault/evidence files keep the same readers.

criterion_3_no_silent_switch_or_replay.evidence: In the rehearsal a broken upstream engine (bad executablePath) fails with E_OPEN and creates no session; there is no fallback to the legacy engine. A foreign session id / ref / cursor is rejected by the other engine rather than being reinterpreted.
criterion_3_no_silent_switch_or_replay.frozenDefault: The default backend remains legacy; changing it stays a separate product decision (not taken here).

validationBoundary: Isolated-fixture rehearsal plus a hash-bound rollback set. It is not a real cutover of user traffic; the product default is deliberately unchanged.
